summary: Cellectis S.A. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing that the FDA granted Regenerative Medicine Advanced Therapy (RMAT) designation to its investigational CAR-T therapy lasme-cel for relapsed/refractory B-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia (r/r B-ALL). The filing contains no transaction, no shareholder vote, no business combination, no tender offer, no activist campaign, and no management change — only a regulatory milestone disclosure. As a foreign private issuer's routine material-event update without special-situation characteristics, this filing defaults to None.
